items.title: 12.5 Role of NO and NO2 in smog and PAN formation

source_refs.note: Topic 12.5 with the Did You Know box on Lahore smog, printed page 277.

blocks.text: NOx is responsible for numerous harmful effects on living organisms. Two of its atmospheric effects are photochemical smog (12.5.1) and the formation of peroxyacyl nitrates (12.5.2). Lahore smog consists of volatile organic compounds (VOCs), NOx, ground-level ozone, particulate matter PM2.5, CO and SO2.
